item.title: Le Pen can run, but can’t hide her policy flaws
item.description:
Source: Straits Times World (Global)
LONDON, July 8 (Reuters Breakingviews) - French judges had already made a convicted felon out of a former president. They have now slapped a detention sentence on a potential future one, far-right leader Marine le Pen. Unlike Nicolas Sarkozy, who did spend some time in prison, the worst the Rassemblement National figurehead can expect is home detention with an electronic ankle bracelet — conditions she hopes to be rid of on appeal.
